newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo bank readies cheap credit for wheat crop.
newsitem.headline: Yugo bank readies cheap credit for wheat crop.

text.p: Beobanka will approve credits worth 37.5 million dinars ($6.44 million) to its customers for purchases of this year's wheat crop under favourable conditions, state news agency Tanjug reported on Friday.
The credits will be approved under National Bank of Yugoslavia (NBY) conditions at interest rates of 1.5 percent per month, it said.
Interest could be reduced further if the central bank changes its discount rate.
The NBY has kept its discount rate unchanged at 2.5 percent per month since March.
Credits for purchases of new wheat are approved to wheat milling enterprises and agricultural organisations with capacities for processing wheat.
Yugoslavia's 1997 wheat crop is officially forecast at around 2.8 million tonnes, up nearly 1.3 million tonnes from last year.
